product_metadata.title: DLD Shower Curtain Hooks, 12 Anti-Rust Decorative Resin Hooks (5 Colors Available) for Bathroom, Baby Room, Bedroom, Living Room Decoration (Red)
features: DLD 12 Shower Rings-12 rust-proof stainless steel rose shower hooks are included in the package. Size: 1.2''x1.4''x2.4 ''.

Stylish home decor rose hook for bathroom, living room, bedroom, children's room, baby room ... Coordinate them with your favorite curtains and curtain linings for more privacy and moisture protection, or to make your curtains more attractive!
Easy Installation-These decorative hooks are suitable for poles with a diameter of 22-30mm (0.8 "-1.1"). Simply fix the shower curtain hook firmly to a straight or curved shower curtain rod by hand.

Gorgeous Decoration-These shower curtain rings feature unique rose designs: red, pink, purple, blue, white. They are beautiful decorations for the bathroom, bedroom and living room that make your curtains more attractive.
The use of high-quality natural resin materials and environmentally friendly coatings is odorless, environmentally friendly and harmless to the human body.
